## Standards

<a id="HclSyntax"></a>

### HCL

`HclSyntax` · `src/terraform.ts:30`

The native syntax of the HashiCorp Configuration Language, which Terraform files are written in: blocks, attributes, expressions, templates. The marks that several constructs share are here, with the layout of the files Trame writes, aligned as terraform fmt aligns them.

Source: HCL Native Syntax Specification (hashicorp/hcl v2, hclsyntax/spec.md); Terraform: style conventions (terraform fmt) · `https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/blob/main/hclsyntax/spec.md`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `endOfLine` | `"\n"` | Ends each line of a file (refines TextFile.endOfLine) |
| `space` | `" "` | Separates two tokens where the layout wants it |
| `indent` | `"  "` | Begins each line of a block's body: two spaces |
| `equals` | `=` | Gives an attribute, or an element of an object, its value |
| `comma` | `,` | Separates the elements of a tuple or of an object written on one line |
| `openBrace` | `{` | Opens a block's body, an object |
| `closeBrace` | `}` | Closes what { opened |
| `quote` | `"` | Opens and closes a quoted template, a block's label |

- Maintained by: trame
- Refines: [Text file](../std/releases/0.14.0/docs/text.md#TextFile)
- Defines: [Attribute](#HclAttribute), [Comment](#HclComment), [Text](#HclString), [Value](#HclValue), [Module call](#ModuleBlock)
- Used by: [Attribute](#HclAttribute), [Comment](#HclComment), [Text](#HclString), [Value](#HclValue), [Module call](#ModuleBlock), [Terraform writer](#TerraformWriter)
- Defines the language: [Terraform](#Terraform)

<a id="TerraformModules"></a>

### Terraform modules

`TerraformModules` · `src/terraform.ts:51`

How Terraform lays out a module, and calls one: the file that holds a module's main content, the meta-argument that says where the called module is.

Source: Terraform: Standard Module Structure; Module Blocks (the source meta-argument, local paths) · `https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/modules/develop/structure`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `main` | `main.tf` | The file of a module's main content: a module named by its directory is read there |
| `module` | `module` | The type of the block that calls a module |
| `source` | `source` | The meta-argument of a module block that says where the module is: a local path starts with ./ or ../ |

- Maintained by: trame
- Used by: [Drivers](languages.md#Drivers), [Module call](#ModuleBlock), [Terraform writer](#TerraformWriter)

### Attribute

`HclAttribute` · `src/terraform.ts:253` · status: **held**

<a id="HclString"></a>

### Text

`HclString` · `src/terraform.ts:160` · status: **held**

A quoted template with no substitution: the text between double quotes, written with the escape sequences the Terraform reader decodes (a quote, a backslash, a line feed…, any other control character in \u form), and with $${ and %%{ where the text holds ${ and %{, so that nothing in it is read as a substitution.

Section: Template Expressions (quoted templates, escape sequences) · `https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/blob/main/hclsyntax/spec.md#template-expressions`

| Mark | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `control` | `32` | The characters below this code are control characters: written as escape sequences |
| `fill` | `0` | Fills a numeric escape sequence up to its number of digits |

| Input | Writes | Checked |
|---|---|---|
| `"reservations"` | `"\"reservations\""` | held, read as Terraform |
| `"a \"b\"\n${c} %{d}"` | `"\"a \\\"b\\\"\\n$${c} %%{d}\""` | held, read as Terraform |

- Owner: trame
- Parameters: `standard` ← [HCL](#HclSyntax) · `terraform` ← [Terraform](#Terraform) · `ecma` ← [ECMAScript](../std/releases/0.14.0/docs/ecmascript.md#EcmaScript) · `counts` ← [Counts](../std/releases/0.14.0/docs/algebra.md#Counts) · `sequences` ← [Sequences](../std/releases/0.14.0/docs/algebra.md#Sequences) · `texts` ← [Texts](../std/releases/0.14.0/docs/algebra.md#Texts)

<a id="HclValue"></a>

### Value

`HclValue` · `src/terraform.ts:210` · status: **held**

A value of the graph, written in HCL: a text, a number, true or false, a tuple between brackets, an object between braces (a key that is not an identifier is written as a text), null for nothing.

Section: Expressions (literal values, collection values) · `https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/blob/main/hclsyntax/spec.md#collection-values`

| Mark | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `openBracket` | `[` | Opens a tuple |
| `closeBracket` | `]` | Closes a tuple |
| `nothing` | `null` | The value of what is not there |
| `identifier` | `^[\p{ID_Start}_][\p{ID_Continue}_-]*$` | An identifier (ID_Start, then ID_Continue or a hyphen): a key that needs no quotes |
| `unicode` | `u` | The flag that lets the pattern read Unicode properties |

| Input | Writes | Checked |
|---|---|---|
| `"reservations"` | `"\"reservations\""` | held, read as Terraform |
| `{"cpu":2,"memory_gb":4}` | `"{ cpu = 2, memory_gb = 4 }"` | held, read as Terraform |
| `[1,"a",-2.5]` | `"[1, \"a\", -2.5]"` | held, read as Terraform |
| `{"content type":true,"memory-gb":4,"empty":{}}` | `"{ \"content type\" = true, memory-gb = 4, empty = {} }"` | held, read as Terraform |
| `null` | `"null"` | held, read as Terraform |

## Language

<a id="Terraform"></a>

### Terraform

`Terraform` · `src/terraform.ts:68` · status: **held**

The language of the modules an implementation provisions, read with tree-sitter's HCL grammar in its Terraform variant: the variables a module declares (its parameters), its outputs, the values written in it. A module is named "hcl" in the graph (code.file(path, "hcl")).

Grammar: [Grammar of HCL](packages.md#HclGrammar) `1.2.0` (`@tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-hcl/tree-sitter-terraform.wasm`) · files `.tf` · named `hcl` in bodies

<details><summary>values: The values written in a module: a negative number is the minus and its number</summary>

```scheme
(unary_operation "-" (literal_value (numeric_lit))) @literal.number
(numeric_lit) @literal.number
(string_lit) @literal.text
(quoted_template) @literal.template
```

</details>

<details><summary>parts: What a text is made of: its fixed parts (escape sequences included, the grammar does not catch them apart), what a template substitutes</summary>

```scheme
(string_lit (template_literal) @literal.part)
(quoted_template (template_literal) @literal.part)
(template_interpolation (expression) @literal.substitution)
```

</details>

<details><summary>keys: A key of an object written as a text that is not an identifier (an identifier may hold hyphens): a value disguised as a name</summary>

```scheme
((object_elem key: (expression (literal_value (string_lit) @literal.key))) (#not-match? @literal.key "^\"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\"$"))
```

</details>

<details><summary>names: What is written like a value but names something: the labels of a block, a key of an object</summary>

```scheme
(block (string_lit) @name)
(object_elem key: (expression (literal_value (string_lit) @name)))
```

</details>

<details><summary>declarations: What a module declares: its variables, the parameters the graph passes; its outputs, what it gives back</summary>

```scheme
((block (identifier) @_type (string_lit (template_literal) @parameter)) (#eq? @_type "variable"))
((block (identifier) @_type (string_lit (template_literal) @output)) (#eq? @_type "output"))
```

</details>

<details><summary>roles: The places that give a literal its role (syntax.LiteralRoles): the value of an attribute, of an object's element, an element of a tuple, an argument</summary>

```scheme
(attribute (expression (literal_value) @role.initial))
(attribute (expression (template_expr) @role.initial))
(object_elem val: (expression) @role.property)
(tuple (expression) @role.element)
(template_interpolation (expression) @role.template)
(function_call (identifier) @callee (function_arguments (expression) @role.argument))
```

</details>

Escape sequences open with `\`; named: `\n` "\n", `\r` "\r", `\t` "\t", `\"` "\"", `\\` "\\"; numeric: `\U` then 8 digits in base 16, `\u` then 4 digits in base 16; written for another text: `$${` for "${", `%%{` for "%{"; otherwise the mark escapes the character that follows it.

| Code | Must read | Checked |
|---|---|---|
| `variable "name" {   type = string }  output "url" {   value = "x" } ` | literals ["\"x\""] · roles ["initial value"] · parameters ["name"] · outputs ["url"] | held |
| `size = { cpu = 2, "memory gb" = -4.5, "ok-too" = true } ` | literals ["2","\"memory gb\"","-4.5"] · roles ["property value","other","property value"] · values [2,"memory gb",-4.5] | held |
| `url = "postgres://${var.name}:5432 $${kept}" ` | literals ["\"postgres://${…}:5432 $${kept}\""] · values ["postgres://…:5432 ${kept}"] | held |
| `list = ["a\n\u00e9", 3] ` | roles ["element of a list","element of a list"] · values ["a\né",3] | held |

- Owner: trame
- Defined by: [HCL](#HclSyntax)
